newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - June 10.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - June 10.

text.p: Following is a summary of major political and business stories in local newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Shanghai. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy.
- SHANGHAI SECURITIES NEWS - New share issues have begun to be less over-subscribed after Beijing took measures to limit speculative funds flowing into the stock markets.
- Central bank Governor Dai Xianglong says China's financial industry is developing in a healthy way, with the central bank managing to keep the Chinese yuan stable.
- A commentary warns wealthy individuals of excessive speculation on the stock markets.
- BUSINESS NEWS - Shanghai's Gross Domestic Product (GDP) increased by a year-on-year 14 percent in the first five months of 1997 to 123.6 billion yuan.
- China now has 130,000 internet users, compared with only 1,600 in 1994.
